notes.title: Hotfix to v.2.1.1
notes.content: - Some fixes in Russian and Korean translations.

notes.title: Day 3 of the Destitute Chapter is now available!
notes.content:
Greetings! Today we are happy to announce that Day 3 of the Destitute Chapter is fully complete. What to expect:

 About 30-40 thousand words or a few hours of reading in most routes. 
 3 new characters, including familiars faces from games of a long bygone era.
 Several new songs and CGs. These are included in Part 4 of the game's OST, which you will soon be able to purchase.

This update is free for all owners of the Destitute Chapter. We are also offering a 10% discount for everyone who hasn't yet had a chance to purchase it, which will last until next week.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865880/Touhou_Fading_Illusion__Destitute_Chapter/

If you encounter any bugs or would like to provide feedback or suggestions, please submit them to our Discord server or in the Steam thread.

We hope you enjoy our game! Good luck!

P.S. David Cronenberg has aged, but his work lives on!

notes.title: Update to version 2.0.1!
notes.content:
Greetings friends! We have received a lot of feedback regarding the game's performance and have fixed a few bugs and issues that were hindering the game:

 Choices map of the Underworld Chapter now works correctly. 
 Backgrounds and CG of the Underworld Chapter are now correctly added to the gallery.

.

Huge thanks to everyone who reported bugs! If you notice anything in the future or have any other comments or suggestions, feel free to write to us in Discord or in the corresponding threads in Steam.

notes.title: "Underworld Chapter" is now available!
notes.content:
Greetings friends! Today we are happy to present you a new DLC for our game! 

In the Underworld Chapter, the narrative will be carried out by Rin Kaembyo, Satori Komeiji, along with Seiji Kijin, who accidentally joins them. Together, they'll be searching (or pretending to search) for a cure for a mysterious disease that threatens to kill all the animals in the Palace of Earth Spirits. However, as we all know, a large part of the iceberg is usually hidden from view, and in order to fully realise the scale of the danger, you need to get down from its top and look under the water.

We remind you that at the moment only the first day is available in this chapter. In it you will find:

 1.5-2 hours of reading.
 2 plot choices leading to three different outcomes.
 Over 10 plot CG in different scenes.
 8 characters with their own detailed sprites.
 Based Koishi with many professions!
.

Unfortunately, Brazilian Portuguese and Japanese translations are not yet available, but we are working on them and will try to add them as soon as possible.

Also in this update we have improved the in-game links system, fixed some bugs in the code, typos in the text and defects in the script. If you find a bug or have any questions or suggestions, feel free to post them in the relevant threads, and if you want to praise or criticise us, we are always happy to receive your reviews on the game or DLC.

Also, to celebrate the release of the new DLC for the next 2 weeks, Destitute and Underworld Chapters will be discounted by 5% and 25% respectively. In some countries, such as Kazakhstan, Ukraine, India, Indonesia and Vietnam, the prices for both add-ons have been additionally reduced because Steam automatically charged an quite high price for some countries and we didn't pay attention to it initially. 

We hope you enjoy our work! See you soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3095760/Touhou_Fading_Illusion__Underworld_Chapter/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865880/Touhou_Fading_Illusion__Destitute_Chapter/

notes.title: Underworld Chapter will be available on September 20!
notes.content:
Greetings, friends! We hope that each of you has had a good start to the school year or a work month without overtime. 

For us, however, the month started with the fact that several artists from our team need a little more time to finish the necessary images, so the release of the Underworld Chapter is delayed until September 20. 

As a reminder, this chapter will only have the first day available at the time of release, but it will contain:

 1.5-2 hours of reading.
 2 plot choices leading to three different outcomes.
 Over 10 plot CGs in different scenes.
 8 characters with their own detailed sprites.
 Based Koishi!

We will also be releasing an update for the base game and Destitute Chapter at the same time as the release of the Underworld Chapter, adding new articles, one new track, and expanding some endings. We hope you enjoy it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3095760/Touhou_Fading_Illusion__Underworld_Chapter/

notes.title: "Underworld Chapter" will be available soon!
notes.content:
Greetings friends, today we'd like to tell you a couple things about the upcoming DLC release and related changes.

 First of all, let's note that the Underworld Chapter will only have the first day available at the time of release, which will consist of about 2 hours of reading and 2 choices leading to 3 outcomes. Roughly the same as the first day of the Destitute Chapter, which became available a year ago. 
 The narrative will be told from three perspectives at once, with Rin Kaenbyou, Satori Komeiji, and Seija Kijin as the protagonists. 
 The DLC will be sold at the same price as the Destitute Chapter.
 We also plan to lower the price of this and future add-ons in some countries such as Kazakhstan, Ukraine or India, as well as regional prices in USD to make the price look more appropriate in comparison to the average salary in these countries.
 We plan to release the DLC in the second half of August. 

Due to the fact that we will now have 2 DLCs available at once, we have changed the subscription terms for our Patreon and now you will be able to get any of the chapters of your choice for each month of your subscription. See the pinned announcement on our page there for details. 

For now, you can add the Underworld chapter to your wishlist, and we'll announce the exact release date in a little while. Bye, we will see you again soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3095760/Touhou_Fading_Illusion__Underworld_Chapter

notes.title: Music room, choices map, new images and translations!
notes.content:
Greetings, friends! Today we are ready to present you an update of the game. It contains:


 Translation for day 2 of the Destitute Chapter into Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and French.
 Japanese translation of the Prologue.
 Music room.
 Choices map.
 A few new images for the Destitute Chapter.
 Some fixes in text and display of some images.

This update does not include the additional Destitute Chapter story content that we talked about in the previous news. It will be in the next update that we are currently working on. 

Also, please note that we are currently looking for translators for Japanese and Traditional Chinese and editor for English translations, as the translators on our team can no longer devote enough time to translation. If one of these languages is your native language (or you are confidently fluent in it), and you have the desire and free time to participate in the game's development, you can write to our working e-mail (vntouhou@gmail.com) or go to our Discord server, where you can contact the main developer. In addition to knowledge of Japanese or Traditional Chinese, decent knowledge of English or Russian is also required to communicate with the developers and understand the game text.

Please be warned, however, that due to our very limited budget we will not be able to pay for your work immediately and therefore we offer you to participate on a mostly volunteer basis.

notes.title: Our plans for 2024.
notes.content:
Greetings friends! Today we would like to announce our plans for the rest of this year. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43228555/4f727a4639469704ec3bf6770f3009955d0a8ee3.png

1. First of all, we would like to inform you that we have decided to do 2 chapters in parallel to be able to release more updates. As we said earlier, a lot of the sprites and backgrounds will be reused in the different chapters, which means that as we've created the Destitute Chapter, we've accumulated a significant amount of material for the Underworld Chapter. It will take us a two or three months to finish all the necessary material, and approximately in early fall we will be able to release the first day of the chapter. We won't make any specific promises for now, so that we don't have to finish everything in a hurry like we did with the last update.

2. As for Destitute Chapter - we plan to do a third day at the end of this year. As with the Underworld chapter, a lot of the material will be reused, and the work will be mostly behind the new CG and text. 

3. The Portuguese and French translations of the second day of the Destitute Chapter are almost ready and will be released soon with an update, which will also significantly lighten its weight by optimizing the resources used. The Spanish translation is a bit delayed at the moment, but we will try to release it as soon as possible. In addition, we have almost finished the Japanese translation of the Prologue and will probably release it separately from the Destitute Chapter translation.

4. Also we are currently working on a big update that will add a music room, an in-game choices map, missing articles and dictionary illustrations, and expand some scenes. All in all, it will make for about 10-20 minutes of reading time. The choice map will look something like this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43228555/5c78c61d3a42db060a45c18e78c9aa641a434c87.jpg

You will see all scenes as blocks with "?" if you haven't reached them yet, and blocks of already passed scenes will contain a brief description of events. We may add a pop-up window with a more detailed description of the scene, because the novel is large and many players may forget some of the previous events. Expect an update closer to the beginning of June.

Don't forget about us! See you soon!

notes.title: Update to version 1.2.2!
notes.content: Greetings friends! We received feedback from players who bought the DLC and made some corrections to the text and interface. As it turned out, in some places in the English text we mixed up the races of creatures (ghosts and phantoms) and slightly incorrectly conveyed the meaning of phrases. We hope that this will make the text clearer and easier to read!

notes.title: The second day of the Destitute Chapter will be available on the 29th of March!
notes.content:
Greetings friends, today we're excited to let you know that we're at the finish line in the development of Day 2 of the Destitute Chapter and are ready to announce a release date! Here are the key points we'd like to highlight right now:


 The update will be available on March 29th and will contain around 4-5 hours of reading time, increasing all of the currently available Destitute Chapter content to 6-7 hours of reading time.
 Russian, English, and Chinese languages will be available at the time of release, with Spanish, Portuguese, and French translations to be added within a few weeks of release.
 Once the DLC is released, the first day of the Destitute Chapter will no longer be free.
 You will be able to purchase Destitute Chapter for 9.99 USD (regional prices may be different) as DLC for the main game, which will remain free and will only contain the Prologue. Keep in mind that by purchasing the DLC you get access to the WHOLE chapter at once, which includes all future updates as well.
 People who purchased the DLC key using Patreon will receive it to their account-linked mail.


You can add Destitute Chapter to your wishlist now, so you definitely won't miss the moment of release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865880/Touhou_Fading_Illusion__Destitute_Chapter/

notes.title: Destitute Сhapter is finally here!
notes.content:
Hello friends! Today, we're happy to announce that the first day of the Destitute Chapter is finally complete, reviewed, and released to the public! You can enjoy it right now and completely free! New content awaits you:

 1-3 hours of reading (depending on your desire to see all new scenes).
 2 choices leading to 3 different outcomes.
 6 new characters with their own detailed sprites.
 10 new CGs (some have variations).
 13 new tracks.

Apart from that, we added a gallery, slightly changed the interface and fixed minor bugs that remained from the previous version.

If you like the update or have any comments, feel free to share your impressions in a review or recommend our game to your friends. You can also support the development of the game on Boosty or by purchasing game's OST. We are very grateful to all those who supported us or are just about to do so! Our game is free, so we wouldn't have been able to finish the update without all your support!

Given that we've been a little behind schedule with this update, it's possible that the next update will also be finished later than we originally planned (late 2023). Some time later, we will write about our future plans, but if you are interested in watching the development progress in more detail, then I suggest subscribing to us on Twitter.

See you and hope you enjoy!

[previewyoutube=ZLX5tmgngMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Major update is almost ready!
notes.content:
Hi guys! Today we are happy to inform you that the first update of our game is almost ready!

The first day of the Destitute Chapter awaits you, the story of which will be presented from the point of view of Reimu and the characters close to her. Already in the first day there will be two choices that will lead you to one of three radically different outcomes, which will later result in a significant plot branching.

Yeah, we were a little late with it and deviated from the originally set schedules, but if you are subscribed to our socials (by the way, highly recommend you to subscribe), you may have heard about the translation problems that we suddenly faced back in early May. However, despite of everything, we still finished our work! So stock up on some yummies and wait - we need only a few more days to check everything!

See you and hope you enjoy!
